name: Optegra Ventures Inc.
summary: Optegra Ventures Inc. operates as a natural resource company, primarily dedicated to acquiring, exploring, and developing mineral properties, with a specific focus on gold and other precious metal deposits. The company's asset portfolio includes an 88% stake in the Cumberland projects, which span approximately 26,000 hectares in Georgetown, North Queensland. It also controls the 6,400-hectare Compass Creek projects located within the Pine Creek goldfield, and holds full ownership (100% interest) of the 6,000-hectare Mt. Turner project, situated northeast of Cumberland. Formerly known as Essex Minerals Inc., the company adopted the Optegra Ventures Inc. name in August 2023. Established in 2012, its corporate headquarters are located in Vancouver, Canada.
